title: Building Production AI Agents with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
body: In this technical deep-dive, we explore how to architect production-grade LLM agents using vector embeddings, hybrid search, and semantic routing. We examine latency benchmarks, hallucination guards, and evaluation metrics.

title: Bootstrapping a Micro-SaaS to $20k MRR: Lessons from 18 Months of Building
body: Here is the exact breakdown of how our 2-person team bootstrapped a developer analytics SaaS from zero to $20,000 monthly recurring revenue without venture capital. We cover pricing experiments, churn reduction, customer support, and cold email conversion rates.

title: Optimizing Video Encoding Pipelines for High-Throughput Short-Form Content
body: A comprehensive benchmark of FFmpeg, NVENC, and AV1 video codecs for real-time mobile playback. Learn how we decreased transcoding latency by 48% while maintaining crisp visual fidelity for 4K video exports.

title: The Engineering Behind Developer Marketing: How to Build Tools That Go Viral
body: Why typical ad campaigns fail with software engineers, and why utility-based marketing (interactive playgrounds, open-source CLIs, and technical cheatsheets) generates sustainable inbound pipeline for developer-first products.

title: Creator Economics: Transforming Newsletter Readers into Paid Community Members
body: How independent creators can build resilient recurring revenue models with premium content tiers, curated community forums, and bespoke member newsletters. Real numbers and retention analysis from 3 creators.
